window_rule: all original saved records with 50 <= physical_time_s <= 70; no interpolation, no response-dependent selection
pair_selection: reuse Pro frozen TRAIN-only static choice, not a new spatial-selection claim
readout: original four native cell-centre concentration values averaged in float64, z=0.20 m; ideal zero-delay simulation readout, no PID hardware claim
primary_comparison: source-pair-cover M1 versus full-window raw-joint on exactly the same native windows and independent DEV worlds
primary_metric: DEV-world MAP xy error; also report strict Top1, ties, Brier, log-evidence margin and costs
inferential_gate: four DEV worlds cannot establish broad 95-percent population precision; retain paired world results and do not count frames as worlds

coarse_sampling_profile.reason: original approximately 0.5-0.6 s records cannot resolve delivered 0.2 s lag and 0.25 s decay; declare a separate necessary sampling adaptation before concentration decode
coarse_sampling_profile.scope: discrete native-sampled coarse cues, not reconstruction or validation of fast olfactory motion

ordinary_reference: regularized Gaussian on the same log1p full paired window, TRAIN-only mean and pooled covariance
full_window_shared_density_head_control: same TRAIN-only pooled-covariance Gaussian for single-side, time-mean pair, mother features and selected M1 features; descriptive adaptation control
density_regularization: diagonal floor 0.1 times average within-source TRAIN variance plus 1e-6; frozen, no tuning
R3_R4_gate: no active experiment unless M1 has independent native gain, temporal qualification and complete legal action/response support; no automatic extra seeds, sources or worlds
